localObserver.note: Owner's machine, 2 s interval, canonical URLs plus a ?cb= cache-busted site.json. Each timeline row is a change in which generation each file served. A regression is a poll where a file served a generation older than one that same file had already served at this vantage point. A mixed poll is one where the files served more than one generation.

perDeploy.note: Window = from this generation's deploy-pages "Reported success!" to the next generation's. pollsWithAnOlderFile counts polls where any JSON file (site.json, ?cb copy, pr/1, pr/2 once it existed) served a generation older than this one; newer generations appearing early are not counted.
